utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let folks know about the repair drive right away. People around here usually show up when there’s a good cause.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks. I’ll keep track of supplies and send over a clear list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check that for you—what details do you need about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye—could you tell me if there’s a date, where it’s happening, and whether they need volunteers or tools?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — I’m still on for this afternoon. I’ll bring the tools and head over on time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks—can we confirm who’s bringing the rest and what time everyone should arrive? I just want to make sure the logistics are clear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just point me to what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great—could you bring a flashlight and work gloves, and meet me at the shed at 9?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Glad to hear it—just let me know if you need a hand while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Ira — I’ll let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll help spread the word and keep folks updated once the list and timing are set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll send over the list and timing once I’ve got them set, and we can keep it organized from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I can help a bit too, just quietly for now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet, but I’ve got my tools ready if anything comes up. I’ll keep an eye on it and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that’s a big help. I’ll let you know as soon as I need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the date, time, and what kind of repairs the drive needs? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with the repair drive, though I’m keeping things a bit low-key right now. I don’t have the full details on the date, time, or exact repairs yet, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — could you bring any basic tools and help sort the donated items when you get here?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but can you confirm people will actually show up? I just don’t want to count on it if it’s still just talk.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Vik said he’ll spread the word and keep everyone posted if anything changes, so we’ve got follow-through in place. I’ll keep an eye on the status too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rosa, are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — we’re still on for this afternoon, and I’m getting the list and timing sorted now. I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as I have the final details.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
